purpose: Compare certified whole-object proof rewrites against elementary path cleanup on fixed public Stable AC certificates.
execution: Cloud auxiliary study; not a native Yohaku continuation and no access to host memories or native budget.
new_frozen_test_selection: Among remaining public training records with length <=20, sort SHA256(official_commit|training_id|proof_reconstruction_cloud_r2_v1), take first16. Freeze IDs and solver SHA before replaying their move lists. This is public certificate postprocessing, not a blind from-scratch solver test.

arms.baseline: Exact repeated-state loop deletion plus replacement by one applicable official primitive.
arms.whole_object: Same cleanup plus left multiplication (3 primitives), unchanged-donor conjugation (4 primitives), and conjugation by h*v^(+-1)*h^-1 (2|h|+4 primitives), for freely reduced h of length<=2 over the current generators. Both targets and signs; no macro counted as a single scored step.

rewrite_matching: Compare exact ordered freely reduced full endpoint to every later state on the supplied current certificate, including rank. Accept only strict primitive-length reduction and full official feasibility. Choose globally minimum resulting primitive length, then full work, peak, start/end indices, expanded move list. Restart after acceptance, maximum three accepted rewrites per arm.
cost_reporting: full official work including initial state
freeze: Implementation/configuration hashes and selected IDs saved before new test path processing. Development runs may expose implementation bugs; every attempt and consumed calls retained. A bug fix after new test access creates a new version and discloses access, never silently restarts the same test.
upload: Publish research/evidence to the authorized GitHub repositories; no competition-platform submission or leaderboard access.
